save.name: Ultimate Save (NO CC)
save.creator: PlumbobKingdom
save.knownIssue: Calendar holidays can make Sims miss work. Fix: open the calendar, filter to Holidays, choose Edit on each holiday, and delete any holiday whose edit screen will not open. You can recreate it afterward.

mods.name: MC Command Center
mods.creator: Deaderpool
mods.notes: Story progression, population and household control. Windows only. Install the core file plus only the modules you want.

setup.note: Let MCCC or the game's Neighborhood Stories handle NPC life events, not both. Turn the other one off.

setup.task: Set MCCC story progression and population
setup.note: Turn on the NPC events you want. If townies start disappearing, check the culling setting under MCCC population.

mods.name: UI Cheats Extension
mods.creator: weerbesu
mods.notes: Edit needs, skills, relationships and traits from the UI. Free on weerbesu's Patreon; install both the .package and the .ts4script from the zip.

mods.name: XML Injector
mods.creator: Scumbumbo
mods.notes: Now maintained by Triplis. Needed by Seasonal Emotions and the Wildlife Biologist and Landlord careers. Remove version 1 when upgrading.

mods.name: Lumpinou's Toolbox
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Script library. Needed by First Impressions. Mods folder or one subfolder, no deeper.

mods.name: Mood Pack Mod
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Needed by First Impressions. The file is Lumpinou_MoodPackMod.package.

mods.name: Universal Venue List
mods.creator: Basemental
mods.notes: Needed by every KiaraSims4Mods active career except Lifeguard, to add their venue lot types. Only one venue list can be in Mods; other venue lists and Lot Extender conflict with active careers. Base game. Basemental lists version 2.58, released 2026-09-07 (checked 2026-10-13).

setup.task: Make sure it is the only venue list
setup.note: Remove any other venue list and Lot Extender. KiaraSims4Mods' guide names them as the main conflict with active careers.

mods.name: Work Interactions Pie Menu
mods.creator: KiaraSims4Mods
mods.notes: Computer > Career interactions for employed Sims. Needed by the Firefighter, Higher Education, Lawyer, Military and Resort Owner active careers. Needs XML Injector. Its page lists Businesses & Hobbies, Discover University, Eco Lifestyle, Get to Work, High School Years, Horse Ranch, Royalty & Legacy and Snowy Escape.

mods.name: WickedWhims
mods.creator: TURBODRIVER
mods.notes: Includes everything in Wonderful Whims, so skip that one. Delete old WickedWhims files before installing a new release.

setup.note: Whims pregnancy overrides MCCC pregnancy by default. If you want MCCC in charge, turn the override off in the WickedWhims settings, then check both mods so only one is active.
Open them the way the creator's page describes and change only what you want.

mods.name: WickedWhims animations
mods.creator: Various
mods.notes: Animation packs for WickedWhims from several creators. Everything in the Mods/Anim folder is a WickedWhims animation (owner, 2026-10-13). Needs WickedWhims. In the 2026-10-13 scan: Azmodan22, KhlasGay, OLL, 0nizu, CIPHER UVS and GreyNaya packs.

mods.name: Basemental Drugs
mods.creator: Basemental
mods.notes: Includes the alcohol features, so you do not need a separate alcohol mod. Free from the site's Adult Mods menu. Redownload after every patch.

mods.name: Slice of Life
mods.creator: Kawaiistacie
mods.notes: Personality quirks, illness, injuries and deeper moods. Each feature downloads separately; put the script file directly in Mods. Creator corrected from Sacrificial on 2026-10-13 (Kawaiistacie's site and Patreon).

setup.task: Choose which Slice of Life features are on
setup.note: Your files include Health and Beauty & Fashion pickers. Use them in game to pick the features you want.

mods.name: Meaningful Stories
mods.creator: roBurky
mods.notes: Redesigns the mood and emotion system. Mood mods overlap, so add one at a time.

setup.task: Go through the Meaningful Stories settings
setup.note: Every feature is optional and can be adjusted in its in-game settings menu (creator's itch.io page).

mods.name: First Impressions
mods.creator: Lumpinou
mods.notes: Shows trait-based first impressions in the relationship panel. Needs Lumpinou's Toolbox and Mood Pack Mod. Download only one version: WithTimeDecay or NoTimeDecay.

mods.name: Seasonal Emotions
mods.creator: Ellesimsworld
mods.notes: Needs XML Injector and Seasons.

setup.task: Choose your season in the Seasonal Emotions settings
setup.note: Sims feel happier or sadder in the season you pick. Needs XML Injector and Seasons.

mods.name: Connected Sims
mods.creator: A.deep.indigo
mods.notes: Adds more than 50 ways for friends and family to interact.

mods.name: Roommate Stories
mods.creator: Kawaiistacie
mods.notes: Roommates get careers, friends and activities of their own.

setup.task: Give your roommates the Roommate Stories career track
setup.note: Its page says to add the career track, or use the cheat careers.add_career KawaiiStacie_RoommateCareers_RoommateStoryCareer. Then play a day and check the roommate leaves and comes back on their own.

mods.name: Dine Out Reloaded (public version)
mods.creator: Carl's Guides
mods.notes: Only edit a restaurant while it is closed. Build the restaurant after installing, or chefs may stand outside. Can get blamed when another mod that touches work shifts is out of date.

setup.note: Restaurants built before the mod was installed can leave chefs standing outside. Only edit a restaurant while it is closed.

setup.task: Set up Carl's Dine Out Settings
setup.note: Includes the option that lets your own Sim work as chef or server.

mods.name: Firefighter (active career)

mods.notes: Active career. Packs: Get to Work, StrangerVille. Also needs: Basemental's Universal Venue List, Work Interactions Pie Menu, XML Injector. Venue: Fire Station. Skills: Fitness, Handiness.
